title: All-quotient coherence of the canonical finite evaluation of tower pullback
statement:
Let $g:T'\to T$ and $A,I,P_n=A/I^n,A_T,A_{T'}$ satisfy [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use its strict reduction functor $\mathcal R_T$ and the canonical universal tower pullback $\widetilde L_0$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $B_n(K)=Lg_n^*(K\otimes^L_{A_T}(P_n)_T)$, regarded as an $A_{T'}$-complex by the finite projection, and let
$$F_{0,n}:\operatorname{ev}'_n\widetilde L_0\mathcal R_T(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}B_n(K)$$
be the canonical finite coefficient comparison induced by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Write $d_{0,b,a}$ for the actual strict tower transition and $d_{B,b,a}$ for the finite target quotient map using the canonical restriction-of-scalars composition identification. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ and $b\geq a\geq1$,
$$d_{B,b,a}F_{0,b}=F_{0,a}d_{0,b,a}.$$
The finite target normalization uses $(x\otimes r)\otimes s\mapsto x\otimes q_{b,a}(r)s$; these identifications satisfy the equal-index identity and the three-index quotient cocycle.
